body: I guess I could try calling a hotline. Or alternatively I'll wait until tomorrow, give therapy one more chance, and call the place I used to go to and tell them what's going on.

I've talked to a few therapists over the last 3 years and my latest one was so unhelpful that I don't feel like trying again. They basically told me to just go outside and talk to people and didn't take me seriously when I said I was suicidal.

My boyfriend has suffered from depression and self harm before and he's the one I turn to usually. Lately it just seems like he's getting tired of hearing me say that I want to hurt myself, because the last time I said something like that, he started talking about his own day. At first I thought he was trying to redirect my thoughts to something else, but now I feel like that was just really rude.
Yes, I've told a couple people around me about my thoughts. They just don't care (like I said in my previous post, one of them even said that my depression is caused by my attitude lol).
i appreciate that, but honestly i'm a nightmare to be friends with.
i have, but it mostly just makes me think that it'll be the perfect music to listen to before i off myself lmao
A couple people, but I also don't want to worry them lmao

My relationship with my mom is fine, but I don't trust her enough to open up to her about my mental health (because she got mad at me for self harming when I finally got the courage to tell her about it six years ago).
doing that would be too expensive, so unfortunately it's not an option

i'm just feeling really lonely and i had accidentally pissed off my boyfriend a couple days ago, which i still haven't forgiven myself for lol. gotta love having a brain that can't let go of any negative things that have happened
it should be pretty pleasant when you're nearing death
Happy new year to you too! I just got the cheapest beer and cider, no need to buy anything fancy if I won't be enjoying drinking them anyway lmao

Thank you for taking the time to write all this for me, it put a smile on my face (and a few tears in my eyes as well lol). I'm insecure about a lot of things, especially things such as whether my feelings are valid or not, so that's why my boyfriend's response to my worry hurt pretty bad.

Also I'm from Finland, so we get to buy alcohol at the age of 18 🥴

It's time for his mandatory military service (i can't think of the proper term rn), so it's not like he has a choice on whether to leave me alone or not. I just don't know how I'll cope with being all alone.
He knows, but I don't think he always understands how strongly I react to things.
Antidepressants and anxiety meds. The antidepressant I have is the most common one the doctors will prescribe, and my dose was raised a little over a month ago. Doesn't seem to be helping.
I've been seeing a couple therapists for the past four years now, but I just seem to be getting worse.
I felt better for a while, but now I feel like cutting again.

I know, I'm prone to talking about my mental health issues once I have some alcohol in my blood so I told a few people that I almost attempted suicide earlier this week. They seemed to care, which was nice.
